Netflix remains the largest US subscription streaming service for the second consecutive year, while HBO Max has overtaken Paramount+ to take sixth place, according to Parks Associates.

The research firm’s annual ranking, based on estimated subscriber numbers through September 2026, leaves the top five unchanged. Netflix leads Prime Video, Hulu, Disney+ and Peacock.

HBO Max moves into sixth, followed by Paramount+, Apple TV, YouTube Premium and ESPN Select.
